name: bifrost
description: The stark skills + tools source repo. Seven bundles served straight from this tree — no build step, no registry, no signed manifest.

plugins.name: stark-analyze
plugins.description: Zero-context fresh-eyes review of specs and briefs, multi-agent Terraform/Terragrunt (IaC) review, repository refactor planning, and application-logging authoring/review guidance. Maps to spec-kit's analyze phase.

plugins.name: stark-constitution
plugins.description: Project setup, decision records, and session priming — scaffold a dev-docs/standards structure (template/backfill/upgrade modes), record architecture decisions (ADRs) under docs/adr/, audit and optimize a repo's agent instruction files (.claude/rules, CLAUDE.md, AGENTS.md), and assign a session persona. Maps to spec-kit's constitution phase.

plugins.name: stark-design
plugins.description: Design-token architecture — build, name, theme, and govern a design-token system the way the field's canonical sources converge on it. Covers the three-tier model (primitive/semantic/component), naming grammar, OKLCH color scales, DTCG authoring, Style Dictionary pipelines, dark-mode/multi-brand/density theming, CSS-variable distribution, WCAG contrast gates, and token semver/deprecation.

plugins.name: stark-implement
plugins.description: Implement from an accepted spec. /stark-build runs one fresh headless session per task gated by checks the agent cannot edit, with a held-out e2e gate, one cross-vendor advisory review, and one bounded fix round for medium+ findings.

plugins.name: stark-ops
plugins.description: Repository operations beyond the spec-driven pipeline — coordinate Minions with Gru, cut releases, run session start/end, hand off work across sessions, run one ticket solo and unattended with Agnes, and open a Lucius brainstorm in a tab of its own.

plugins.name: stark-plan
plugins.description: Turn a design doc into a phased implementation plan, then decompose it into phased GitHub issues with story points and risk labels. Maps to spec-kit's plan + tasks phases.

plugins.name: stark-write
plugins.description: Long-form writing craft, from the author's reusable voice profile through story editing, adversarial sharpening, independent judging, and multi-model jury calibration.
